items.title: I Found the Secret to Long Range WiFi!
items.description: Curious how Antennas actually work? Download Mouser's free Antennas Guide: https://mou.sr/4gjf08z Check out the antennas featured in this video: L-com antenna: https://mou.sr/4weUtrl Siretta Oscar 18 directional antenna: https://mou.sr/4z6WBEr More Siretta antenna solutions: https://mou.sr/4z9EVry Check out the NanoFarfield Test Setup here: https://www.crowdsupply.com/antenom-antenna-technologies/nanofarfield https://www.antenit.com/nanofarfield/ Previous video: https://youtu.be/aKSIhqiKjm4 Previous WiFi Antenna video: https://youtu.be/Q_5bna_cyBw Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/greatscottlab Twitter: https://twitter.com/GreatScottLab Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/great.scott.lab/ TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@greatscottlab Discord: https://discord.gg/zuAvkAuhsY Support me for more videos: https://www.patreon.com/GreatScott?ty=h In this video we will be once again having a closer look at WiFi Antennas. So in this video, let's test 3 commercial directional Yagi Antennas, find out how they are made and ultimately create a DIY version. Will my DIY attempt will work at all or even perform better?
